She learned it during a hurricane season at a regional utility, when line crews found out about a rate freeze from the radio, and she still discusses that week only over coffee. Later she guided a group of clinics through openings and closures with slim message houses and generous mentoring. Her habit of asking who, what and why should I care came from her grandmother, who edited a Bridgetown church newsletter. Nobody has ever seen Karen without her berry lipstick.
